name: The Flesh
description: Grow the computer. Retrofit racks down the Bio ladder, from the Organoid Cabinet to the Neural Vat. Each rack holds a lot of compute for little power, but the tissue must be fed, held at 37 °C and kept clean. Bio points come only from Bio racks, scaled by how open the Flesh still is. At seal 100 it closes. At 99% corruption the tower absorbs you.

name: The Garden
description: Let the machine belong to the planet. Retrofit racks down the Green ladder, from the Neuromorphic Rack to the Photonic Mesh. Green racks run on air and sip power, and they crawl on grid power and run at full speed on clean power. Sun, wind and sold heat raise the green score. At seal 100 it closes.

name: The Singularity
description: The cheapest and fastest. Retrofit racks down the Synthetic ladder, from the Liquid Rack to the Mind Lattice. Nothing is asked of you but cooling and power, and the Lattice never closes. Everything it builds scars the Flesh and the Garden.
